You stand where everyone can see you, raise your voice and turn a scattering retreat into a line that holds.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and up to three willing allies within 4 squares that can hear you.
Duration
Condition reduction and movement are immediate; Boons expire when used or the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn.
Type
Signature

Each recipient reduces one Frightened or Dazed condition by up to 2, to a minimum of 0, and gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. Each may immediately move 1 square without provoking. Resolve movement in an order you choose. This applies to ordinary conditions.

Additional rulings
